constraints.database: fresh database per validator, booted once, then npm run seed; nothing else pre-loaded
constraints.accounts: scripts/create-test-member.mjs: member@test.local and the admin, platform and career terms accepted (--no-terms only for steps that test terms)
constraints.browser: the pinned Chromium named in the release-loop args; no other browser
constraints.fixtures: only the fixtures written in the spec and its appendices, created through the UI unless a precondition says otherwise
constraints.codeUnderTest: the integration-branch commit named in the report; the only variable between rounds

Open the **Rules & why** tab. In **Levels and why**, row **Forecast modeling**, column **Your override**, choose **Advanced**.
Return to **Infographics**.
In the Configured list press **Edit** on "1. Skill strength". Untick **Show footnote**.
Set **Top rows** (in the same edit panel) to `2`: the preview shows only Process design and Forecast modeling (no Pricing analytics). Set it back to `4`. Press
Press **+ Add** on each of the other five career cards without opening them (Trend Bars, Outcome Tiles, Career Timeline, Skill Years Dots, Industry Share Bars).
Press the up arrow ("Move up") on row 2.
Press the remove (✕) button on the last row.
Press **Save & Set Primary** (bottom of the editor).
Reload the page, open the same editor and tab again.

**Empty member:** a brand-new member sees each career card with a plain sentence (e.g. "No proficiency levels yet — add skills or tools in Career Master...") an
**Failed load:** if Career Master data cannot be loaded, an orange alert says which data failed (with the HTTP status) and "This is a loading error, not missing
**Top rows blank:** clearing the number box falls back to the chart's default (not zero rows).
**Classic charts:** Bar Chart and Capacity Gauge cards need a roll-up source; their **+ Add** is disabled until one is available.
**Console:** any error other than the sandbox's `ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID` for an external resource is a failure.
